register: # SOK SK48V100 48V 100Ah LiFePO4 Server Rack Battery — BMS Modbus RS485
# Internal BMS: PACE BMS model P16S100A; protocol: PACE_MODBUS (RS485 variant)
# Interface: RS485A port (RJ45 on front panel); also CAN bus (separate port)
# RS485 wiring: RJ45 port; pin 4 = Data+ (A); pin 5 = Data- (B); pin 6 = GND
#   Multi-battery daisy chain: RS485B port of unit N → RS485A port of unit N+1
#   Set DIP switch on each battery to unique address (1=ON = address 1; etc.)
#   Master battery DIP: address 1; do NOT set any battery to address 0x00 (master mode disables RS485)
# Modbus function code: FC03 (read holding registers); FC06 / FC16 (write)
# Unit ID: DIP-switch selected (1 = default master; 1-8 for parallel stacks)
# All values are uint16 unless noted; scaling in note column
# PACE BMS register map; addresses are decimal (0-based PDU address)
